notes: Updated from the supplied first-floor v2 master. Enlarged study, kitchen and especially little-door room; directly hall-facing main staircase; two-step porch approaches from authored grade Y=3. Fully furnished second floor, raftered miniature-circus attic and brick basement with recessed exterior entrance. Basement floor lowered to Y=-2. Original turret, roofs, facade, conservatory and retained first-floor details extended/adapted rather than replaced. Vanilla Java 1.20.1 palette only. Decorative mirrors, fixtures and circus props do not simulate reflection, plumbing, animation or portal behavior. Live Minecraft testing is still required.
